notes: 分享面板新增「用其他应用打开」（走系统文档打开通路，签名工具更认这条路）；「分享 IPA」额外注册 public.data / public.item 类型，修掉部分签名工具列不出本应用的问题；主界面流光背景速度提到约 6 秒一轮（原来 13 秒）
notesEn: Share sheet: new "Open in Another App" entry (document-open path, more reliable for signing tools). "Share IPA" now also registers public.data / public.item so more tools show up. Home-screen fluid background sped up to ~6s per cycle (was 13s).
